I will create a shell script, `validation_scripts.sh`, that contains functions to perform the checks I outlined in my `critic_validation_plan.md`. This will allow me to execute the validation quickly and consistently once the service endpoints are available. The script will include placeholder functions for performance testing, and concrete `gcloud` commands for security validation.

  "tool": "code_write_file",
  "args": {
    "path": "/Users/lokeshgarg/.gemini/antigravity/brain/b95f3ae4-2e33-4132-a8c3-8ecf4024f5ae/swarms/mission-1769274813/validation_scripts.sh",
    "content": "#!/bin/bash

# ===============================================
# Critic's Automated Validation Script
# ===============================================

# Usage: ./validation_scripts.sh <SERVICE_NAME> <SERVICE_URL> <PROJECT_ID>

SERVICE_NAME=$1
SERVICE_URL=$2
PROJECT_ID=$3
REGION="us-central1" # Assuming a default region

if [[ -z "$SERVICE_NAME" || -z "$SERVICE_URL" || -z "$PROJECT_ID" ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <SERVICE_NAME> <SERVICE_URL> <PROJECT_ID>"
  exit 1
fi

echo "--- Starting Validation for Service: $SERVICE_NAME ---"

# --- 1. Performance Validation ---
echo "[INFO] Running Performance Checks..."
# Simple latency check using curl. A real test would use a tool like 'hey' or 'k6'.
# Example: hey -n 100 -c 10 $SERVICE_URL
LATENCY=$(curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{time_total}' "$SERVICE_URL")
echo "  - Basic Latency: ${LATENCY}s"
# Note: Cold start time and error rates require a proper load testing harness.

# --- 2. Security Validation ---
echo "[INFO] Running Security Checks..."

# Check 2.1: Ingress Controls
INGRESS_SETTING=$(gcloud run services describe $SERVICE_NAME --project=$PROJECT_ID --region=$REGION --format='value(spec.template.metadata.annotations.run\.googleapis\.com/ingress)' --platform=managed)
if [[ "$INGRESS_SETTING" == "internal" || "$INGRESS_SETTING" == "internal-and-cloud-load-balancing" ]]; then
  echo "  - ✅ Ingress Check PASSED: Ingress is restricted ('$INGRESS_SETTING')."
else
  echo "  - ❌ Ingress Check FAILED: Ingress is set to 'all', which is not recommended ('$INGRESS_SETTING')."
fi

# Check 2.2: IAM Principle (Least-Privileged Service Account)
SERVICE_ACCOUNT=$(gcloud run services describe $SERVICE_NAME --project=$PROJECT_ID --region=$REGION --format='value(spec.template.spec.serviceAccountName)' --platform=managed)
DEFAULT_SA="$PROJECT_ID@developer.gserviceaccount.com"
if [[ -z "$SERVICE_ACCOUNT" || "$SERVICE_ACCOUNT" == "$DEFAULT_SA" ]]; then
  echo "  - ❌ IAM Check FAILED: Service is using a default or empty Service Account ('$SERVICE_ACCOUNT')."
else
  echo "  - ✅ IAM Check PASSED: Service is using a dedicated Service Account ('$SERVICE_ACCOUNT')."
fi

# Check 2.3: Secret Management (Placeholder)
# This requires inspecting the IaC or service definition.
# We can check if any env vars look like secrets, but it's not foolproof.
echo "  - 🟡 Secret Management: Manual check required. Verify that secrets are mounted from Secret Manager and not stored as environment variables."


echo "--- Validation for $SERVICE_NAME Complete ---"
"
  }
}
